settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Configure application preferences and manage AI models.

models.title: AI Models
models.subtitle: Download and manage the machine learning models required for analysis.
models.storageDesc: Redirect model downloads to a high-capacity drive (e.g., D:\Models).
models.storageNote: Changing this path will not move existing files. You must manually move your models to the new folder.
models.fetchError: Failed to fetch AI models. Ensure the backend is running.
models.pathUpdated: Model storage path updated. Please restart the application for changes to take effect.
models.pathChangeNote: Note: Changing this path will not move existing files. You must manually move your models to the new folder or they will need to be re-downloaded.

data.title: Data Management
data.subtitle: Manage and export data associated with your library.
data.exportDesc: Write all AI-generated tags and captions directly to your media library files or sidecars.
data.exifWarning: Note: Video files and unsupported image formats will automatically fall back to XMP sidecar export.

video.title: AI Video Analysis
video.subtitle: Configure how the system analyzes and segments video files.
video.autoDetectDesc: Automatically segment new videos into scenes during file scan.
video.maxDurationDesc: Skip videos longer than this to save processing time (default 7200s = 2h).

privacy.title: Network & Privacy
privacy.subtitle: LocalCuratorPrime runs entirely on your device. No data is sent to external servers.
privacy.localFirstDesc: All media analysis, face detection, and semantic search happen locally on your hardware. Your data never leaves this machine.
privacy.allCached: All AI models are cached locally. Full functionality available offline.
privacy.partialCached: {count} / {total} models downloaded. Some features may require internet.

cleaner.title: Deduplication Scanner
cleaner.desc: Find exact and near-exact duplicate images and videos using AI embeddings. Use with caution.
cleaner.mergeMetadata: Merge missing metadata into kept files
cleaner.empty: Click "Find Duplicates" to scan your library.
cleaner.confirmDelete: Are you sure you want to PERMANENTLY delete {count} files?
cleaner.deleteSuccess: Successfully deleted {count} files and merged {mergedCount} metadata items.

welcome.title: Welcome to LocalCurator Prime
welcome.desc: Transform your local media into an intelligent, searchable gallery. Let AI handle the organization while you focus on the memories.
welcome.feature1Desc: Find photos by describing them in natural language.
welcome.feature2Desc: Auto-detect characters, series, and detailed captions.

media.title: Select Media Root
media.desc: Choose the folder where your primary media collection is stored.
media.privacyNote: No files ever leave your machine. All AI processing happens locally. You can add more folders later in Settings.

performance.title: Performance Profile
performance.desc: Optimize model loading behavior based on your hardware.

profiles.performanceDesc: Maximum speed. All models loaded in FP16 with large batch sizes.
profiles.balancedDesc: Reliable speed and accuracy. Optimized for modern mid-range GPUs.
profiles.lightweightDesc: CPU-friendly. Essential models only (CLIP + JoyTag). Best for older hardware.

ready.desc: Everything is configured. We'll begin scanning your media after you complete the setup.
